title: Site tests counted fetch( in the hub's whole HTML, so a post card mentioning fetch() turned main red
problem: Two hub tests in platform/pages/build.test.mjs ('usage counting is local...', 'the offline offer is honest...') matched fetch(, XMLHttpRequest and sendBeacon across the entire rendered index.html. The hub shows the latest posts' descriptions, so a post about code that says fetch() in its description failed the site suite with a message about tracking, not about the post. The run had to find the cause and reword the post.
evidence: prompts/runs/2026-11-25-session_01XpHqyemh9faFayXEcBV*.json errors: "site test 'usage counting is local' failed: the post's description said fetch(), the hub shows it on the latest-post card and the test counts fetch( calls; reworded"
change: build.test.mjs gains pageCode(html): inline script bodies (JS or module types, not JSON-LD) plus on* handler attributes. The two hub tests read that instead of the whole page, and a unit test pins that prose and JSON-LD are ignored while an onclick fetch is still caught.
metric: run records whose errors or doc_friction name a site test failing on prose in a post or tool blurb (fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon)
baseline: 1 record (PR #18765) in the 3 days to 2026-11-25; the class recurs whenever a technical post is published
